about: Every apeGmsh symbol the skill says is removed or not shipped. Lint rule R1 (lint_model_script.py) flags each one in a model script, and tests/test_removed_symbols.py proves each one absent from the live code: its parent resolves and only the last name is missing. Skill prose may say a symbol is removed only when the symbol is listed here. An 'attribute' entry names a symbol as the skill spells it: g, fem, ops and results are the session, the FEMData snapshot, the apeSees bridge and the Results reader; 'from' or 'import' says where any other first name comes from; 'also' lists other spellings of the same symbol. A 'member' entry names a value that a container no longer holds; R1 flags it as the 'keyword' argument of each call in 'calls', which maps the call to that argument's position. 'status' is 'removed', or 'planned' for a symbol the skill says is not shipped yet.
